title: ASVspoof 2019 LA
description: Logical-access dataset of bona fide and spoofed speech made with TTS and voice conversion systems. A standard benchmark for spoof detection.
author: ASVspoof Consortium

title: ASVspoof 2021 DF
description: Deepfake track with compressed audio from many codecs to test detectors under real-world conditions.
author: ASVspoof Consortium

title: WaveFake
description: Generated audio from several neural vocoders for studying vocoder artifacts in fake speech.
author: Frank & Schönherr

title: In-the-Wild Audio Deepfakes
description: Real and fake recordings of public figures collected online to test how detectors generalize outside the lab.
author: Müller et al.

title: AASIST
description: Graph-attention model that works on raw waveforms. A common baseline for anti-spoofing research.
author: Jung et al.

title: RawNet2 Baseline
description: End-to-end raw-waveform detector used as an official ASVspoof baseline.
author: Tak et al.

title: Does Audio Deepfake Detection Generalize?
description: Shows that detectors trained on lab datasets lose much of their accuracy on real-world fakes.
author: Müller et al.

title: What Is an Audio Deepfake?
description: Short introduction for non-specialists: how voice cloning works and where it shows up.
author: CISAAD Team

title: Hands-on: Training a Spoof Detector
description: Notebook workshop: load ASVspoof data, extract features and train a simple classifier in Python.
author: CISAAD Team

title: Spectrograms and Speech Features
description: Explains MFCC and LFCC features and why they help separate real from synthetic speech.
author: CISAAD Team

title: Evaluating Detectors with EER
description: How to compute equal error rate and t-DCF and read the results correctly.
author: CISAAD Team

title: Tennessee ELVIS Act
description: Protects a person's voice and likeness from unauthorized AI imitation.
author: State of Tennessee

title: FCC Ruling on AI Voices in Robocalls
description: Treats AI-generated voices as artificial voices under the TCPA so robocalls using them need consent.
author: FCC

title: EU AI Act Transparency Rules
description: Requires that deepfake audio and video be labeled as artificially generated.
author: European Union

title: NO FAKES Act
description: Proposed federal right to control digital replicas of a person's voice and likeness.
author: U.S. Congress
